preconditions.description: The number of jewelry pieces n must be between 1 and 100000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum number of colors k followed by the colors of each piece of jewelry.

postconditions.expression: all(colors[i] != colors[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n) if (i + 2) % (j + 2) == 0 and is_prime(j + 2))
